# Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All CI checks pass (`all-green` status check is green).
- [ ] At least one reviewer has approved this PR.
- [ ] New or modified behavior is covered by tests (unit, smoke, or fixture-based as appropriate).
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated (README, docs/, CONTRIBUTING.md, etc.).
- [ ] No unrelated files or build artifacts are included in the diff.
- [ ] The PR description clearly explains *what* changed and *why*.
